title: 第9章 千仞雪欲打入敌人内部，加入史莱克学院
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“来了！”

正在思考的贝贝被唐雅一句话打断，宠溺地笑了笑后，武魂附体，为唐雅护法。

而那头濒死的曼陀罗蛇也终于迎来了它的终局，被唐雅一刀结果，化作一个紫色魂环被她吸收。

“蓝电霸王龙，看来是蓝电霸王龙家族的余孽.......”

“老师，我不懂，你明明不喜欢那两个人，为何会把曼陀罗蛇最终让出来。”

霍雨浩终于问出来了，也让千仞雪的注意力再次回到自己的徒弟身上，眼神中带着一点欣赏。

她算是发现了，自己的徒弟真的不是一个简单的人，从收徒到现在，两人相处不过一天，她便发现了这个孩子的优点。

虽然性格因为仇恨有点偏激，但聪明果敢，有一双善于发现问题的眼睛，真的无愧于灵眸武魂。

“看出来了？”

“嗯，虽然不懂，但老师似乎很不喜欢唐门和史莱克，从而也就不喜欢唐雅两人，对吗？那您为何将曼陀罗蛇让出来。”

“看来你很介意，我的徒弟很向着老师，这是个好习惯，为师喜欢。那为师就告诉你吧，我确实讨厌唐门和史莱克，但究其原因又不只是唐门和史莱克，我只是不喜欢一切关于唐三和初代史莱克七怪的。至于其他，我还不至于为难两个小辈。”

“老师不喜欢，那弟子也不喜欢了。”

虽然不知道为何，但霍雨浩无条件跟随千仞雪，这让千仞雪很满意。

即使老师讨厌的是他从小到大崇拜的对象，唐三又哪里比得上老师啊！

霍雨浩很丝滑的转变了，不得不说有前途。

天梦冰蚕也不喜欢。

“雨浩，你的老师我很喜欢，我们一起抱大腿吧！我还是第一次见不喜欢那位的人类呢！”

“不行，老师是我一个人的，只能我抱老师大腿，天梦哥，你那么厉害，靠自己吧！”

“你！小气！”

小气吗？还好吧！

霍雨浩看了一眼千仞雪，觉得理所当然。

观千仞雪，得到位面之子无条件站队自己后，她高兴的拍了拍小家伙的头颅。

“可这样你就去不了史莱克学院啊。你的修炼我虽然能交，但是很多东西还是老师给不了的，比如跟同龄人的相处。”

Page (1/3)

"Coming!"

Beibei, who was thinking, was interrupted by Tang Ya's words. After smiling lovingly, his martial soul possessed him and protected Tang Ya.

And the dying mandala snake finally met its end. It was killed by Tang Ya and turned into a purple soul ring that was absorbed by her.

"The Blue Electric Tyrannosaurus seems to be the remnant of the Blue Electric Tyrannosaurus family..."

"Teacher, I don't understand why you finally gave up the mandala snake when you clearly don't like those two people."

Huo Yuhao finally asked, and Qian Renxue's attention returned to his apprentice again, with a little appreciation in his eyes.

She finally discovered that her apprentice was really not a simple person. From the time she accepted the apprentice to the present, they had only been together for one day, and she discovered the child's advantages.

Although his personality is a bit extreme due to hatred, he is smart and courageous, and has a pair of eyes that are good at spotting problems. He is truly worthy of the spiritual eye martial spirit.

"Did you see it?"

"Well, although I don't understand, the teacher seems to dislike Tang Men and Shrek very much, and therefore dislikes Tang Ya, right? Then why did you let the Mandala Snake out?"

"It seems that you mind very much. My apprentice is very attracted to the teacher. This is a good habit, and I like it as a teacher. Let me tell you, as a teacher, I do hate Tang Clan and Shrek, but the reason is not just Tang Clan and Shrek. I just don't like everything about Tang San and the first Shrek Seven Monsters. As for the rest, I won't embarrass the two juniors."

"If the teacher doesn't like it, then the disciple doesn't like it either."

Although he didn't know why, Huo Yuhao followed Qian Renxue unconditionally, which made Qian Renxue very satisfied.

Even if the teacher hated the person he had admired since childhood, how could Tang San compare to the teacher!

Huo Yuhao's transformation has been very smooth, and I have to say that he has a bright future.

Tianmeng Bingsi didn't like it either.

"Yuhao, I like your teacher very much. Let's hug each other! This is the first time I've seen a human who doesn't like that person!"

"No, the teacher belongs to me. I can only hold the teacher's lap. Brother Tianmeng, you are so powerful, just rely on yourself!"

"You! Stingy!"

Stingy?well enough!

Huo Yuhao glanced at Qian Renxue and felt that it was natural.

Watching Qian Renxue, after getting the son of the plane to side with her unconditionally, she happily patted the little guy's head.

"But you won't be able to go to Shrek Academy. Although I can handle your training, there are many things that the teacher can't give you, such as getting along with peers."
